traditional: Love, money, and pleasure combined with limitation and structure. One benefic, one malefic: the benefic tempers the malefic.

modern.blend: Affection and value meet limit. Loyalty, restraint in pleasure and love, and a strong sense of obligation.
modern.harmonious: Committed, steady, and loyal in relationships and finances.
modern.hard: Difficulty enjoying success, fear of loss, blocked rewards, and free-floating guilt.
modern.business: Loyal and hardworking; the risk is joyless striving and a belief that reward must be suffered for.

cyclicNote: This pair runs a full conjunction-to-conjunction cycle; waxing/waning phase meaning is carried on the transit entries.

provenance.cyclic: applied per-aspect on transit entries (cyclic model)
